notes.title: Update 0.612 New countries
notes.content:
1. Formable countries have been added:
- North American Federation
- Latin American Union
- European Federation
- Roman Empire
- USSR
- Russian Empire
- Eurasian Union
- Scandinavia
- Yugoslavia
- United Nations of the Earth
In this version of the game, country formation is only available through military means. To form a country, you must control all the marked regions.
2. Market capacity for each type of product has been added to the country's economy. Businesses will stop operating if the market is full.

notes.title: Update 0.611
notes.content:
1) After saving the game, a notification about success or error appears.
2) The minimum increase in political will has been increased.
3) The economic power of a social group is now calculated as a percentage. This is the share of the money supply that belongs to the social group. In future updates, ways to change the shares of groups will be added.
4) The mechanics of creating companies have been improved: now a social group can create a limited number of companies, depending on their wealth.
5) The productivity of mining enterprises has been increased.
6) In Salekhard, the sulfur deposit has been replaced with gas.

notes.title: Update 0.603
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug with saving/loading the game, leading to a crash. 
2. Fixed a bug when the selection material did not disappear from the region.

notes.title: Update 0.602 Regional services
notes.content:
1) Regional services have been added. Now you can influence the growth/decrease of the population.
2) A notification about the study of technology has been added.
3) A bug has been fixed where natural resources could not be extracted.

notes.title: Update 0.601 Frontline
notes.content:
1) Frontline mechanics added. Less micromanagement, more strategic planning.
2) A report appears after the battle.
3) New types of ground troops added.
4) New technologies and goods added.
5) When forming an army, the limitation on the number of battalions has been removed.
6) Fixed a bug due to which trade convoys did not appear.

notes.title: Update 0.600 Political system
notes.content:
Another step in the development of the game!
1. Work on the political system has begun. Laws have been added, political will has been added. Laws affect the ideology and political system in the state. Political will is used to perform various actions. The starting parameters are not configured for all countries.
2. AI-controlled countries can start a war with their neighbors.

notes.title: Update 0.530

notes.title: Nuclear update! v 0.522
notes.content:

2. Added technologies for obtaining nuclear weapons.
3. Fixed a bug due to which there was too high demand for goods.
4. Fixed a bug when companies did not pay income tax.

notes.title: Update 0.521
notes.content:
1. Reduced worker requirements for all industries.
2. Fixed a bug where the production conversion price was not written off.
3. Fixed a bug where fiber is now in the resource list.
4. Fixed a bug with overlapping pause menu.
5. Borders of countries at war are now red.
6. Added a visual effect for combat.

8. New functionality has been added to the "Regions" top menu for more convenient management of the economy.

notes.title: Major update 0.520
notes.content:
A major update is here!
1. The game has been ported to a different engine version.
2. Performance has been increased and graphics have been improved.
3. The economy and technology have been partially reworked.
4. Saves don't work yet, but we'll fix it soon.

notes.title: About the upcoming update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740932/2e714d3dc91dafabe06cfd2d46ad678d3f862ed1.jpg

Let's lift the veil of secrecy over the new patch.

While studying options for increasing the game's performance, we settled on the option of transferring the game to another version of the engine. Unfortunately, you can't just copy the project to another version. You have to manually transfer the game logic.

Moreover, some aspects are being corrected and improved (compared to the old version). For example, the economic system has been modernized - now there are economic sectors in the regions (electricity generation, agriculture, resource extraction, resource processing, manufacturing, services). The player can choose the production technology for the economic sector in a specific region. The groundwork has been laid for a larger number of resources and production chains.

At the same time, we are improving the game in the visual aspect. In general, a lot of work has been done, there is also a lot left, but the game will become significantly better. It's worth the wait)

notes.title: Scientific update 0.510
notes.content:
1. Added mechanics for the scientific level of the region and the state. Now the quality of education in the region is important for scientific progress.
2. Added construction technologies until 2090, and rebalanced other technologies.
3. Added the ability to enter into a scientific partnership with another state.
4. Rebalanced some economic parameters. The state's income will increase.
5. Added the ability to build enterprises in other countries.
6. Fixed the logic of concluding peace. The player now decides when to start negotiations. AI in a war against AI annexes the loser.
